note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Great Divide District) on 35-acre Beaver Lake, about 15 miles west of Mellen: a small, quiet loop in maple, birch and red pine, with a short trail to the North Country Trail and Morgan Falls and St. Peter's Dome a short drive away. Dog friendly. No trailhead or long-term parking for trail users in the campground. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + FS read: $15, 10 nonelectric sites (2, 6, 9 tent-only), 6 reservable late May-Labor Day with a 4-day cutoff, rest first-come; 2027 season 05-01 to 10-11; max 35 ft (rec.gov) vs 25-30 ft (FS). Lakefront kept on site 7 only, with a caveat; 5 and 8 are views.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored lakefront (a Claude value, evidence 'sites 5,7,8 lakeside'). Kept only on site 7 (46.30150,-90.89841, reservable nightly): ~20 m from the shore on imagery, and its rec.gov photo shows the table on open grass at the lake's edge with only scattered trees. Site 5 (46.30188,-90.89855, ~30 m) looks at the lake through a brush and tree strip, and site 8 (46.30136,-90.89818, ~20 m, first-come) has no photo and sits under continuous canopy on imagery: both views. rec.gov tags 4, 5, 7 and 8 'Lakefront'; site 4 is ~45 m off in forest. If the reviewer will not rest the value on one site, lakeview.
MAX LENGTH: rec.gov Max Vehicle Length 35 ft at sites 4 and 5; the FS page posts 25 ft for every back-in except 8 (30 ft). rec.gov outranks; a 23-ft rig fits either way.
SEASON: 2027 is 05-01 to 10-11 on rec.gov rate seasons; stored 05-01/10-15 is the FS page's line. The FS page shows 'Site Closed' (closed for the season; boat landing open).

PHONE: stored 715-264-2511 is one of the two numbers rec.gov lists ('(715) 634-4821 OR (715) 264-2511'); the FS page now names the Hayward office, 715-638-7243. Suggest 715-264-2511 -> 715-638-7243, or keep; reviewer's call.
PIN: stored 46.3016,-90.8978 is at the loop's centre (site centroid 46.30180,-90.89769, ~25 m). Fine. The rec.gov facility point (46.30083,-90.87833) is ~1.5 km east and wrong.
